name: Onna-musha
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 235 leadership
pitch: A Heroic-era anti-cavalry pike line sitting at C-tier - meta but very situational rather than a priority pick. Documentation is thin beyond a stale 2023 veterancy build, and what little else exists just flags it as a tight formation that hero AoE like Nodachi's Samurai's March is built to break up.

veterancy.label: Recommended build
veterancy.body: Captured from a level 24, 5-star veterancy screenshot: max the top branch's first five nodes at 3/3 → 2/2 → 3/3 → 3/3 → 2/2, and the bottom branch's first three at 3/3 → 3/3 → 3/3, leaving the deeper nodes on both branches unspent. It's a house screenshot from June 2023 though, about 3 years stale, so treat it as a rough starting point rather than a current recommendation.

battleRole.tips: Chain Dart & Scimitar users can't really threaten this unit - no AoE to punish a tight formation with. {4}

cards.name: Nodachi
cards.why: Samurai's March (press twice) sends soldiers flying on the 2nd hit - built to punish tightly packed formations like this one

gaps: No Amya guide exists for this unit - the tierlist row is the only Amya-sourced content.

No positioning, formation, doctrine, or control-loop guidance exists anywhere - the only battle-role and matchup content comes from two hero pages, Nodachi and Chain Dart & Scimitar, mentioning Onna-musha as a matchup reference point rather than a dedicated guide.
Blob/Flank/Skirmish/Duelling fight ratings aren't available - Onna-musha doesn't have an entry for them anywhere.
Confirmed NOT on the 13-unit [Chaos: A Realm Divided] balance-change list from 25 June 2026 - the most recent balance patch didn't touch this unit specifically.
Two named doctrines exist for this unit, Onna-musha Assault Doctrine and Onna-musha Blood Doctrine, but with no usage advice attached to either - so they're not included as doctrine entries here.
